[[Wilderness of Bahdza]] | henchman = y | material trader = y | merchant = y | rare material trader = y | storage = y | weaponsmith = y | pic1 = [[Image:Dzagonur Bastion world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Dzagonur Bastion inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} '''Dzagonur Bastion''' is the militaristic frontier outpost of [[Vabbi]] under the rule of [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]]. {{Quotation|game| The gateway to the mighty [[Citadel of Dzagon]], the '''Bastion''' is a hub of activity for mercenaries, recruiters, and merchants of arms and armor. Locals are more than willing to sell you any manner of implements for wounding, killing, and maiming, as well as the armor to deflect other adventurer's {{sic}} purchases. }} ==Getting there== If you have selected [[Master of Whispers]] over [[Margrid the Sly]], the [[primary quest]] [[Calling the Order]] will conclude here.
